evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 慈云普护
evidence.excerpt_zh: 碧桐書院之西為慈雲普䕶前殿南臨後湖三楹為歡喜佛塲其北樓宇三楹有慈雲普䕶額上奉觀音大士下祀關聖帝君東偏為龍王殿祀圓明園昭福龍王（圓明園冊）臣等謹按慈雲普䕶四十景之一也與歡喜佛塲額皆世宗御書龍王殿額曰如祈應禱關帝殿額曰昭明宇宙皆世宗御書又龍王殿額曰功宣普潤聨曰正中徳備乾符應利濟恩敷解澤流皇上御書
evidence.summary: West of 碧桐書院 on the Back Lake 後湖: a three-bay front hall (歡喜佛塲), a three-bay tower with Guanyin above and Guandi below, and an eastern 龍王殿 for the garden's 昭福 dragon king.

evidence.title: 慈云普护: 乾隆九年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
evidence.date: 乾隆九年 (1744), date from the compilation
evidence.locator: p.153 item (1), under 慈云普护
evidence.excerpt_zh: 偎红倚绿帘栊好，莺声浏栗南塘晓。高阁漏丁丁春风，多少情幽人醒午梦。树底浓阴重，蒲上便和南，枞枞声色参。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 慈云普护, 1744. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 慈云普护: 嘉庆元年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
evidence.date: 嘉庆元年 (1796), date from the compilation
evidence.locator: p.154 item (2), under 慈云普护
evidence.excerpt_zh: 环绕莲台下，皈依般若禅。慈云布三界，法雨散诸天。溉润敷多稼，醍醐沃福田。杨枝祈遍洒，鉴此寸心虔。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 慈云普护, 1796. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 慈云普护: 嘉庆三年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
evidence.date: 嘉庆三年 (1798), date from the compilation
evidence.locator: p.154 item (3), under 慈云普护
evidence.excerpt_zh: 示慈应感神州遍，天竺海南迹总同。紫竹香云飘物外，绿杨甘露滴虚空。境随心转诸缘扰，想自因生六道通。毕竟形骸归土木，现身说法警愚蒙。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 慈云普护, 1798. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 慈云普护瞻礼
evidence.locator: v2 p.18, under 慈云普护; source ref 1-233
evidence.excerpt_zh: 层阁临湖景象幽，瓣香虔谒为民求。消魔敬愿大雄力，早释圣皇宵旰愁。湖北教匪刘之协等以左道煽惑愚民，经官兵剿捕，窜逸稽诛，致秦蜀匪徒间有闻风窃发，并阑入豫境。统兵大臣等层层剿洗，在穽之兽，自无虞漏网。惟为时已久，皇父盼望献俘，露布宵旰，倍殷悬廑。惟仰冀大雄威力，速清魔障，以纾圣虑焦劳尔。
evidence.summary: Poem 慈云普护瞻礼 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1797, filed by the editors under 慈云普护.

evidence.title: Scene 7, 慈云普护 Ciyun Puhu, Island of Shrines
evidence.excerpt_other: A three-storied bell tower with a sun dial on its south front, and shrines to Buddha, to the God of War, and to the Dragon King were grouped around a cove on the west side of this small island.
evidence.summary: Three-storey bell tower with a sundial on the south front and shrines to Buddha, the God of War and the Dragon King, round a cove on the west side.

evidence.title: 释圆明园慈云普护之多神殿
evidence.summary: 慈云普护 Ciyun Puhu, north shore of 后湖, 120 x 90 m, 800 m2 of buildings. A temple garden for several faiths: 欢喜佛场 for Buddha, a tower with 观音 above and 关帝 below, and the 龙王殿 for 昭福龙王. Cites a 1794 repair list giving three bays with a three-bay rear annex for 欢喜佛场.

evidence.title: 慈云普护 龙王殿, 关帝殿 (S47 section 2.1)
evidence.summary: East side hall of 慈云普护 is the dragon-king hall: three bays, hanging gable, facing west, with a front terrace and the plaque 如祈应祷. The two-storey building north of it had Guanyin above and Guandi below; a Qianlong note puts a Daoist cell beside it. Table dates both to Kangxi.

evidence.title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 慈云普护
evidence.locator: from p.153, under 慈云普护
evidence.summary: 慈云普护: 3 dated items, 1744-1798, of which 3 poems (Qianlong, Jiaqing). First dated 1744, last dated 1798.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v2, editors' note on 慈云普护
evidence.summary: A temple garden on the north shore: main hall to Guanyin above and Guandi below, a dragon-king hall to the east, a hexagonal bell tower. Eunuch monks served here until 1839.
